caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet, which is rendered in a realistic style. The bonnet has a quilted texture, predominantly colored in brown, with the top and side panels exhibiting a diamond quilted pattern and the lower portion featuring a diagonal ribbed texture. Along the edge of the brim, there is a distinct blue section, bordered by a thin brown strip. Attached to the left side of the bonnet is a brown decorative bow, made from the same material as the ribbons. Two long and wide brown ribbons extend downward from each side of the bonnet, ending in loose, soft folds. The background is plain and light beige, with minimal shading or additional detail, which emphasizes the form and detail of the bonnet itself.
title: Zoar Bonnet
